 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Los Angeles. Los Angeles, October 24, 2026, is set to experience a pleasant day filled with sunshine and comfortable temperatures. The forecast indicates a high of 26°C and a low of 15°C, making it an ideal day for outdoor activities. With no expected precipitation and a very low chance of rain at 0%, residents can expect a dry and enjoyable atmosphere throughout the day. Los Angeles Weather Today
 Today's weather in Los Angeles offers a delightful blend of sunny skies and mild temperatures. The maximum high will reach 26°C while the lowest temperature settles at 15°C, providing a comfortable range for all outdoor plans. Humidity levels are projected to be around 85%, contributing to a nice, warm feel, especially during midday. With calm winds sustaining a maximum condition of 19.31 km/h, the day will be characterized as having plenty of sunshine, delivering an overall agreeable environment. No rain is forecasted today, ensuring that the sunny spell will dominate. As the hours progress, residents should expect slight variations in temperature, with the warmth peaking in the afternoon.  As evening approaches, the weather remains favorable for outdoor gatherings and activities. With a clear sky expected, families and friends can enjoy their time without concern for sudden rainfall. It is wise to pack for a warm evening, as temperatures will gradually decrease but remain comfortable. Travelers should take full advantage of these conditions, perhaps planning a stroll along the beach or dining al fresco. There’s no need for rain gear today, allowing for a carefree venture outdoors. Residents are encouraged to stay hydrated as the sun shines brightly throughout the day. Los Angeles Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 In the upcoming week, Los Angeles is likely to continue enjoying mostly warm and sunny conditions. The warmest day is expected to be October 26, with a high of 28°C, while the coolest day will be on October 30, with a low of 17°C. Most of the week will bring sunny weather, making it a great time for any outdoor engagements or outings. Clouds may make brief appearances, particularly towards the end of the week, but no significant rainfall is expected. Residents should note that daytime temperatures will generally hover around the mid-20s, maintaining a pleasant feel across the city. In conclusion, today's weather in Los Angeles offers a refreshing day filled with sunshine and warmth, mirrored in the upcoming week with continued pleasant conditions.
